paper_title: Direct Detection of Dark Photon Dark Matter with the James Webb Space Telescope
notes: Projection paper. The authors propose a theoretical sensitivity to dark photon dark matter (DPDM) kinetic mixing (ε) using a modified JWST configuration during ground-testing phases. They use existing JWST NIRSpec and MIRI observation data to forecast achievable limits of ε ~ 10^-12 – 10^-14 in the 10–500 THz frequency range. This is not a new measured limit but rather a proposal for future sensitivity with modified mirror configuration. The paper states this approach can be applied to future space telescopes such as LUVVOIR, HabEx, Origins, and Roman during ground-based testing.
